summary: Iteration 6 — end-to-end backend testing of Super Admin Command Center, vendor onboarding with optional GST + vendor_category, unified 20% commission with 80/20 service split, 50/50 delivery split, urgent 80/20, convenience-fee-as-platform-revenue, stenographer hourly booking with min_hours/serviceability checks, file page-count auto-detection on upload, and DPDP auto-purge on order completion. Added 25 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_courtbazaar_api.py under classes TestIter6Services / TestIter6PricingEngine / TestIter6Stenographer / TestIter6VendorCategories / TestIter6VendorOnboarding / TestIter6FilePageCount / TestIter6AutoDeleteOnCompletion / TestIter6CommandCenter / TestIter6Regression. ALL 25 iter6 tests PASS. Full suite: 126/127 PASS (1 pre-existing flaky AI test — /api/ai/filing-checklist returning 502 from upstream LLM, unrelated to iter6).

minor.issue: Intermittent 502 from upstream LLM (preview env). Pre-existing in iter5; not caused by iter6 changes.

action_items: Investigate /api/ai/filing-checklist 502 — likely Emergent LLM call exceeds ingress idle timeout; consider increasing timeout, streaming, or moving to async job.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py calculate_pricing (L656-715) correctly implements unified 80/20 service split, 50/50 delivery (DELIVERY_SHARE_VENDOR_PCT=0.5), urgent 80/20, convenience-as-platform; split_details matches review spec exactly. Math verified: 100*₹1 + ₹79 chamber + ₹10 convenience -> vendor_payout=119.5, platform_revenue=69.5, GST=34.02, total=223.02.

Seed (server.py L272-277) force-unifies platform_commission_pct=0.20 across all services with update_many; even though court_seed.py still has 0.25/0.30 literals, the runtime override correctly normalises all 48 services to 0.20. Consider also fixing court_seed.py literals for consistency.

Stenographer serviceability check (server.py L2027) uses `is False` so courts missing the `serviceable` field (e.g. court_karnataka_hc) silently PASS the check. Currently only Delhi courts and a few state HCs (e.g. Bombay HC) have the field set in DB. This means a stenographer booking could succeed for a non-Delhi court that simply lacks the flag. Recommend changing to `not court_info.get('serviceable')` to default to non-serviceable, mirroring the intent stated in the 400 message.
VendorOnboard (server.py L217-232) correctly adds vendor_category/has_gst/bio/hourly_rate; values persist on update_one with full payload spread. OK.

Auto-purge on completion (server.py L815-822) works end-to-end: files.is_deleted=true, deleted_reason='order_completed:<order_id>', orders.files_purged.deleted=N. Verified via DPDP /my-data and order detail.
Command Center (server.py L1890-1989) returns the full payload spec'd in the request and aggregates only payment_status=paid orders for revenue. Forbidden for non-admin (403). OK.
File size: server.py is now 2107 lines — recommend splitting into routers (orders, files, vendors, admin, stenographers) for maintainability.
Page-count detection (L595-615) handles PDF (PyPDF2), images (1), docx; falls back to 1 on error. Safe.
